article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Michael Zanoni put up 30 points as Pennsylvania beat Drexel 89-74 on Tuesday night. Zanoni shot 9 of 10 from the field, including 3 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 9 for 9 from the free-throw line for the Quakers (4-3). Ethan Lin had 13 points and went 5 of 9 from the field (3 for 5 from 3-point range). David Simonovic led the Dragons (3-3) in scoring, finishing with 20 points and six rebounds. Drexel also got 17 points and three steals from Amaree Abram. LaDricus Pittman finished with 12 points, five assists and two steals. Penn took the lead for good less than 3 1/2 minutes into the game and the score was 52-28 at halftime, with Zanoni racking up 20 points. Penn pulled away with an 8-0 run in the second half to extend a 13-point lead to 21 points. The Quakers were outscored by Drexel in the second half by a nine-point margin, but still wound up on top, as Zanoni led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
